title: Procurement Manager
description:
About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.
 We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.
 Where we are today:
 Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover
 Seven European markets live
 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai
 $40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.
 We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.
 What You Will Do Identify, engage, and acquire suppliers across Europe and worldwide.
 Lead negotiations for pricing, payment terms, and contracts of €1M+ procurement spend.
 Build strong commercial relationships that fuel company growth and ensure reliable supply.
 Develop and execute strategic plans to drive operational growth and efficiency, aligning with the company's global objectives.
 Collaborate with Sales and operational teams to solve issues and improve operational processes that leverage automation and data.
 Analyze performance data, track key KPIs, and deliver actionable insights to optimize end-to-end supply chain operations.
 Analyze market trends, supplier capabilities, and pricing structures, and adjust strategy accordingly.

title: Senior Finance Manager (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.
 lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.
 As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.
 Your Mission
 Your mission is to be an integral part of building and scaling the Finance function within lemon.markets. As Senior Finance Manager you develop processes and policies as well as support the Product Development team and other functions - becoming the go-to person for external stakeholders and auditors. You will play an important role in establishing lemon.markets as the go-to-provider for launching investment products in Europe.
 At lemon.markets we value ownership a lot. Meaning you have a lot of autonomy in shaping your area of responsibility. Your report directly to our VP of Finance and collaborating closely with Risk Management, Product, Compliance, among others, making sure our Finance function is set up for long-term operational excellence and scalability. title: Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Company Overview
   Focused Energy is the leading laser-driven fusion company, dedicated to creating clean, limitless fusion power. We unite top scientific and engineering talent to unlock commercially viable fusion energy using proven technologies. Our goal is to drive economic growth and scientific innovation through the adoption of clean, abundant fusion energy worldwide.
   Your Role
   As a Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in designing, modeling, and optimizing advanced cryogenic thermal and fluid systems for commercial-scale fusion energy solutions. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to develop, simulate, and validate experimental designs, helping define the roadmap toward efficient and scalable clean energy.
   What You’ll Do
   Own the end-to-end simulation and analysis function for cryogenic thermal and fluid systems—from problem definition through model development, validation, and continuous improvement.
 Lead analytical approaches for new and undefined challenges, applying first-principles research to create pioneering solutions.
 Drive model validation through close collaboration with experimental engineers, comparing simulation outputs to test data, and closing performance gaps.
 Ensure that the Cryo team’s hardware decisions are consistently supported by robust quantitative analysis.
 Develop integrated thermal and fluid analysis packages for commercial-scale system development, conducting optimization and sensitivity studies as needed.
 Continuously refine analysis models as new experimental, materials, and system data become available.
 Partner closely with hardware engineers, experimentalists, and scientists to define system requirements and deliver actionable analyses for design.
 Provide the analytical foundation for the Cryo team’s technical roadmap, guiding what gets built, tested, and scaled.

title: Praktikum Fundraising und Campaigning
description:
Wir von GermanZero machen Deutschland klimaneutral – von unten. Als gemeinnütziger Verein treiben wir gemeinsam mit Hunderten ehrenamtlich Aktiven die Umsetzung von Klimaneutralität voran: Ort für Ort und auf Bundesebene. Mit unserem Netzwerk LocalZero unterstützen wir Städte und Gemeinden auf dem Weg zur Klimaneutralität. GermanZero ist spendenfinanziert. Die Organisation hat aktuell rund 40 hauptamtliche Mitarbeitende und lebt vom bürgerschaftlichen Engagement mehrerer Hunderter ehrenamtlich Aktiven.
 Stellenbeschreibung
 Du hast Lust auf ein Praktikum, bei dem du dich für den Klimaschutz einsetzen kannst? Du möchtest gerne in die Fundraising-Abteilung einer gemeinnützigen Organisation reinschnuppern, hast Spaß daran, komplexe Themen rund um Klima und Politik zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten und hast Lust, die wichtigste Kampagnen-Saison mitzubegleiten? Super! Dann bewirb dich als Praktikant:in für unser Fundraising-Team mit dem Schwerpunkt Stiftungs- & Kleinspendenfundraising ! Wir suchen eine:n neue:n Praktikant:in ab 1. September oder 1. Oktober 2026.
 Mögliche Aufgaben:
 Recherche von neuen Stiftungen und Fördermittelgeber:innen : Du identifizierst neue Trends sowie potenzielle Stiftungen, Aufrufe und Ausschreibungen, die zu unseren Projekten und strategischen Zielen passen, und erstellst Übersichten zu deren Förderkriterien und -schwerpunkten.
 Kampagnen-Planung & Umsetzung: Du unterstützt bei der inhaltlichen und gestalterischen Umsetzung für Fundraising-Kampagnen, vom ersten Konzept bis zur Ausspielung über Mail oder Social-Media – insbesondere unsere Weihnachtskampagne
 Mitwirkung an Kommunikationsmaßnahmen & Spendenaktionen : Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Quartalsupdates, Rundmails, Spendenmailings, Förder-Aufrufen und besonderen Aktionen, die unsere Unterstützer:innen und potenzielle Fördermittelgeber:innen erreichen.

title: Senior System Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Bei virtual7 verbinden wir unsere technologische Expertise mit einem tiefen Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden. Durch maßgeschneiderte Lösungen schaffen wir einen echten Mehrwert für unsere Rahmenvertragspartner in der öffentlichen Verwaltung. Aktuell suchen wir für einen unserer Kunden einen Senior System Engineer (m/w/d).
 Projektstandort: Bonn/Nürnberg
 Zeitraum: 17. Oktober 2026 bis 31. Dezember 2026
 Arbeitsmix: 40 Tage Remote/ 5 Tage vor Ort
 Wichtig: Remote-Arbeit nur in Deutschland möglich
